descriptionChirho: The proper name Naphtali, referring to the sixth son of Jacob (by Bilhah) and the Israelite tribe descended from him, along with their territorial allotment in northern Canaan. All four clusters are the same name with different prepositions: bare nominative/genitive, with lamed (to/for Naphtali), with beth (in Naphtali), and with min (from Naphtali). Multilingual glosses confirm identity: Arabic Naftali, Spanish Neftali/Naftali, Hindi Naptali, Korean Napdalli, Swahili Naftali. No semantic distinction exists between these grammatical variants of one proper noun.
